novel_features.name: Cross-mailbox search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across all synced mailboxes at once — find any email regardless of which mailbox received it.
novel_features.rationale: API search is per-mailbox only; cross-mailbox search requires N sequential API calls without local cache.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs to find a specific email and doesn't know which mailbox has it, one search beats iterating.

novel_features.name: Oversight velocity
novel_features.description: See approval/rejection rates and median decision latency per mailbox across your entire fleet.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining audit events with oversight decisions in local SQLite; no API endpoint aggregates decision velocity cross-mailbox.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent's sends are stuck in approval queues, this pinpoints which mailbox's operator is the bottleneck.

novel_features.name: Trust ladder status
novel_features.description: Fleet-wide view of each mailbox's oversight mode, time-at-level, and upgrade history.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining mailbox configs with audit events filtered for upgrade actions; API returns current mode but not progression timeline.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Before requesting a trust upgrade, an agent should know which mailboxes are ready and which have been at their current level longest.

novel_features.name: Allowlist coverage
novel_features.description: See what percentage of recent recipients are covered by allowlist patterns vs gated.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining allowlist entries with sent emails and matching exact + wildcard patterns locally; no API endpoint diffs these.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Before adding allowlist entries, an agent should know which recipients are already covered and which cause the most gating friction.

novel_features.name: Inbox health
novel_features.description: Per-mailbox health snapshot: unread count, oldest unread age, reply rate, and thread depth.
novel_features.rationale: Requires aggregation over synced emails table; no API endpoint returns these composite metrics.
novel_features.why_it_matters: An agent monitoring its own inbox health can detect when it's falling behind on replies before the operator notices.

novel_features.name: Stale thread detection
novel_features.description: List conversation threads with no reply in N days — surfaces dropped conversations.
novel_features.rationale: Requires time-windowed join of threads and emails in local SQLite; API has no 'inactive threads' query.
novel_features.why_it_matters: A dropped conversation thread is a customer-facing failure; this is the agent's early warning system.

narrative.headline: Every MultiMail feature, plus cross-mailbox search, oversight analytics, and trust ladder tracking no other tool has.
narrative.value_prop: Full CLI access to MultiMail's agent email platform. Manage mailboxes, send and read emails, configure oversight modes, and manage sending allowlists. Local SQLite cache with FTS5 search enables cross-mailbox queries, oversight velocity tracking, and trust progression analysis that the API alone cannot provide.

quickstart.comment: Cache all mailboxes and emails locally
Search across all mailboxes at once

troubleshoots.fix: Check that MULTIMAIL_BEARER_AUTH is set. Get a key via `multimail-pp-cli auth register`.
Mailbox is in gated_send or gated_all mode. Check `oversight pending` and approve, or add the recipient to the allowlist.
Run `multimail-pp-cli sync --full` first to populate the local cache.
This is the two-step OTP flow. Check operator email for the approval code, then rerun with --approval-code.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you need shell-level access to MultiMail — in CI/CD pipelines, Docker containers, SSH sessions, or agentic shells where MCP is unavailable. The local SQLite cache and FTS5 search make it the right choice for cross-mailbox queries, oversight analytics, and trust progression tracking that the per-mailbox API cannot provide.
